biography_sections.title: The younger William remains unresolved
biography_sections.markdown:
The **1783 Connor** probate material is lost; its surviving index gives no heir, executor or death date. A 1772 Larne deed names Wm Glasgow as witness, but gives no detail assigning him to William-3326 rather than William-1505. Independent church, estate or deed evidence is still required.

Source: [Registry of Deeds, Miller to Drennan, 12 May 1772, manuscript p. 315](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSH3-SQLT-3).
